workouts.name: 2x20 Sweet Spot
workouts.description: Two 20-minute blocks just below threshold. Big aerobic payoff for the effort — settle in, keep the pressure steady, and resist surging on the second block.

workouts.name: 4x8 VO2
workouts.description: Four 8-minute repeats slightly above threshold with 4 minutes easy between. Long enough to pull oxygen uptake near its ceiling without the sting of short VO2 work.

workouts.name: 5x5 VO2
workouts.description: The classic five-by-five: 5 minutes hard, 5 minutes easy, five times. Simple to remember, brutally effective at raising your aerobic ceiling.

workouts.name: 6x1 Anaerobic
workouts.description: Six 1-minute efforts well above threshold with long recoveries. Trains the capacity to attack, close gaps and survive surges — quality over quantity, every rep full gas.

workouts.name: Big Gear 5x5
workouts.description: Five 5-minute low-cadence strength blocks at sweet spot — 55-60 rpm, seated, driving from the hips. On-the-bike strength work without touching a squat rack.

workouts.name: Endurance 120
workouts.description: The long aerobic ride: two hours in Zone 2. Fuel from the start — a bottle an hour and something to eat at 45 minutes. Builds the engine everything else sits on.

workouts.name: Endurance 60
workouts.description: A time-crunched aerobic hour: 45 steady minutes in upper Zone 2. The pace should feel almost too easy for the first 20 minutes — that is the point.

workouts.name: Endurance 90
workouts.description: Ninety minutes of steady Zone 2 with cadence variety: high-cadence spin-ups and low-cadence strength blocks keep it engaging while the aerobic engine does its quiet work.

workouts.name: 30/30s 3x10
workouts.description: Three sets of ten 30-second surges above threshold with 30 seconds float between. Accumulates big time near VO2max without the dread of long intervals.

workouts.name: Over-Unders 3x9
workouts.description: Three 9-minute blocks alternating 2 minutes just under threshold with 1 minute just over. Teaches your legs to clear lactate while still working — race-winning fitness.

workouts.name: Pyramid 1-2-3-2-1
workouts.description: A pyramid of 1-2-3-2-1 minute efforts just above threshold with matching recoveries. Climbs to a 3-minute peak, then descends — short, sharp, and over before it gets boring.

workouts.name: Recovery 45
workouts.description: Forty-five genuinely easy minutes. The discipline here is keeping the power DOWN — this ride makes the hard days work, it doesn't add to them.

workouts.name: Sprints 8x30s
workouts.description: Eight 30-second sprints at 150% with long, full recoveries. Trains raw power and the snap to close a gap — quality over quantity, every rep from fresh-ish legs.

workouts.name: 3x12 Sweet Spot
workouts.description: Three 12-minute sweet-spot blocks — the stepping stone toward 2x20. Same pressure, shorter bites, generous recovery.

workouts.name: Tempo 3x15
workouts.description: Three 15-minute tempo blocks at a comfortably hard pace. Builds the muscular endurance that makes long threshold work possible later in the season.

workouts.name: Tempo 60
workouts.description: A continuous 40-minute tempo block — the "comfortably uncomfortable" zone. Builds fatigue resistance and mental patience for long sustained efforts.

workouts.name: Threshold 2x15
workouts.description: Two 15-minute efforts right at FTP with 5 minutes between. The most honest workout there is — if FTP is set right, this is hard but doable.

workouts.name: 3x10 Threshold
workouts.description: Three 10-minute efforts right at FTP with full recoveries. The classic threshold builder — less daunting than 2x15, same adaptation.
